items.title: Orrin Keepnews interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are in San Francisco filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m extremely pleased to be speaking with Orrin Keepnews today

ctx.x: Orrin Keepnews was born in New York City on March 2, 1923. He has played an important role in jazz as a record producer, writer and as a creative force with Riverside, Milestone and Landmark Records. Orrin produced classic recordings with Thelonious Monk, Bill Evans and Cannonball Adderley and continues to work in jazz from his home in San Francisco.
Orrin was interviewed in San Francisco, California on August 7, 2002 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
